name: eye-adapter
description: The adapter surface's schema carrier (the bridge/carrier ruling, 2026-10-28): adapters and connectors are strictly bridges - they never define, author, or evolve schema; whatever touches schema rides a pack under the packstruct@1 grammar. This pack carries eyestruct-adapter@1: the bridge-only dispatch list, the shared refusal grammar, the never-exits law, and the proposal-only canon rule (no ratify through a bridge, an adapter-side adopt is always unratified).
